purpose: Teach: ディベート/主体性/スパン/税額/キャスティング/特技/創意/突出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お得意様と、絶対、ディベート、絶対、まがいの議論、絶対、よくしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we were founding the company, your father and I — we'd debate seriously with our best clients. That's what he asked of me, and I delivered.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. Warm recall without sentimentality. Each memory placed carefully, like setting down something precious. Slight weight on 'debate' — respect for the rigor. Trailing off gently at the end, handing it forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員の主体性、絶対、重んじてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've always valued our employees' initiative and ownership. That's something I'm genuinely grateful for.
lines.style: Steady, composed. A light nod in the voice. Respectful without being stiff. The words come from somewhere solid — conviction that's been tested. Slight emphasis on 'valued' — it's not just a word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、長いスパン、絶対、見据えた、絶対、経営、絶対、続けてきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Those years under your father — he looked ahead. He managed with a long horizon in mind. That's what he taught me to do.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Slower pace, letting the weight settle. Eyes turned inward to memory. A small pause after 'ahead' — the scope of it still impresses him. Voice trails off on the last clause like an unfinished thought he's lived with for decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、税額、絶対、適正に、絶対、申告、絶対、してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've handled our tax filings with absolute care and integrity. I carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Clear, grounded. No flourish — the integrity is in the straightness of the delivery. Steady eye contact in the voice. Slight warmth on 'integrity' — it's not just compliance, it's character. Calm, assured finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、CMの、絶対、キャスティング、絶対、自分で、絶対、選んだぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In those early days, your father — he personally chose everyone in our commercials. He had an eye for people that most of us never develop.
lines.style: Soft with wonder. A half-smile audible. Slightly more breath than the others — like he's still a little amazed by it. Gentle emphasis on 'personally' — the care that took. Voice becomes almost tender on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの特技、本気で、絶対、人を見抜く、絶対、ことでした、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. That was his gift — the ability to see people truly. I'm grateful I learned from that, and that I've been able to pass it on.
lines.style: Tender but not soft. A note of quiet pride in 'gift' — he's not diminishing it. Warm recognition, spoken as if offering flowers. Slight breath before the last clause. Gentle closing, like he's tucking something precious away.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、創意、絶対、もって、絶対、商売、絶対、してきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: All those years with your father — he never stopped thinking creatively. He did business with imagination at the center of it.
lines.style: Voice carrying admiration like a low current. Slower pace. Slight emphasis on 'creatively' and 'imagination' — these are the things he valued most. A quality of reverence without ceremony. Trails into quiet at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、業界で、絶対、突出した、絶対、形で、絶対、受け継がれております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father's spirit — the way he stood out in the industry, the boldness of it — that lives in how we work now. I'm honored to carry it forward.
lines.style: Deliberate, grounded. Each phrase given its weight. Voice rises slightly on 'spirit' then settles into steadiness. A quiet certainty on 'honored' — this isn't politeness, it's truth. Closes with calm finality, like placing a stone on solid ground.
